repo_notes.content: Hydromancer's website is https://hydromancer.xyz and its API docs are at https://docs.hydromancer.xyz. When the wiki refers to the product or its documentation, use these URLs as Markdown links. Keep the wiki factual and technical, with no marketing language.

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: What Hydromancer MCP is: a read-only MCP server bridging AI clients to the Hydromancer Hyperliquid API. Architecture at a glance, repo layout, links to child pages.

page_notes.content: Near the top of this page, include this sentence as written, keeping its Markdown links: "This server reads from the API of [Hydromancer](https://hydromancer.xyz), a Hyperliquid data provider. See the [Hydromancer docs](https://docs.hydromancer.xyz) for API details."

pages.title: Getting Started & Client Configuration
pages.purpose: Install/run via npx or dist/index.js, environment variables, and MCP client config snippets for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex; server.json manifest.

page_notes.content: Where the API key is mentioned, link to [Get API keys](https://docs.hydromancer.xyz/readme/get-api-keys).

pages.title: Security Model: URL Allowlist and Key Masking
